title: 第3章 有人参第4章 使植物快速长大
slug: 凡人修仙我只是个路人甲
content_zh:
“起了。”林鹤清赶紧下床去开门。
“节哀啊小阿清，把饭吃了，一会我们一起把你爹娘安葬了，振作起来，啊。”村长爷爷摸摸林鹤清的头说。
“嗯”，不知道为什么，林鹤清一想到今天就要把爹娘安葬了，心里莫名的不舍，眼泪也控制不住的流了下来。
还没等他拿起那半块窝头，嗓子就哽住了，不停流泪，最后大哭了起来。
“唉”，村长只好牵起他的手，把他带向隔壁的屋子，那里放的正是小林鹤清的爹娘。
看到尸体的一瞬间，林鹤清的眼泪更是止不住的流，林鹤清跪倒在他娘身体边上，不停地哭，完全不受林鹤清的影响。
林鹤清就像在空中看着这场景，却操控不了身体，应该是小林鹤清回来了。
林鹤清眼看着自己的身体跟着大人们走，大人叫他干什么，他就干什么。
花了一上午时间，村民们把小林鹤清的爹娘安葬在一起。
林鹤清在空中也越看越沉默，也难过了起来，刚来到这个世界，自己又变成孤儿了。
回到家里，小林鹤清躺在床上，睁着眼睛看着房顶，林鹤清不知道他能不能看见自己，只对小林鹤清说，“别伤心了，一切都会好起来的”。
他说完这个话，小林鹤清说话了，“哥哥，我要离开了，我要和我的爹爹娘亲一起离开了。”说完他闭上了眼睛。
林鹤清感觉自己又进入了小林鹤清的身体，而且感觉到，小林鹤清不会再回来了。
他应该是和自己的父母一起去投胎了吧，这样也好，一家人在一起。
“我会好好生活的，在这里”，林鹤清暗暗发誓。
小孩子的身体经过一上午的劳累已经疲惫不堪了，林鹤清躺在床上沉沉睡去。
“阿清，起来吃晚饭了”，是张阿婆，张阿婆家的茅草屋离林鹤清家不远，林鹤清五分钟就可以走到，但是对于一个腿脚不好的老人来说，这段路可能就要走上二十分钟了。
张阿婆说起来也是命途多舛的，林鹤清在晒谷场玩的时候，听见村里的张铁牛的娘张王氏和她媳妇闲聊的时候说。
张阿婆本来是张家村头张柱子的女儿，年轻的时候不知道为什么和家里吵架了，一气之下搬到村尾，在公共场合再不见他们一起出现。
而林鹤清的爹娘定居在这最后面，是因为不管是砍柴还是采草药都是靠这山才能得到的，所以就决定在最后面住了。

“哎，好，阿婆你来了，谢谢您给我带饭”，林鹤清打开门，他把阿婆请进房间，接过阿婆带来的碗。
“阿婆，每天叫您给我送饭也不好意思，我娘已经教过我怎么做饭了，以后我也要自己尝试自己做饭了，我也该长大了。”
“那怎么行，你这小块头，灶头能不能够得着哦”，张阿婆拒绝。
“阿婆，我总要学会自己生活，要不我先试试，如果不行，我再找您。”
林鹤清还是打算先自己尝试一下生活，毕竟自己内心是个快三十岁的人，总是麻烦老人家也不好。
而且，自己身上还有秘密，不适合和别人住在一起。
送走阿婆，现在其实才下午四点，村子里平时都是一天吃两顿的，农忙的时候才可能有一天三顿。
刚刚林鹤清在阿婆来之前醒了，试了一下他得到的“灵清界”空间，发现他可以肉身和灵魂一起进去。
其实这个不叫灵魂，按照修仙界的叫法，这个其实叫意识或者说它叫神识。
content_en:
"Get up." Lin Heqing quickly got out of bed and opened the door.
"My condolences, little Aqing. Eat your food. We will bury your parents together later. Cheer up." Grandpa, the village chief, touched Lin Heqing's head and said.
"Well", for some reason, Lin Heqing felt inexplicably reluctant when he thought about burying his parents today, and tears flowed down uncontrollably.
Before he could pick up the half of the steamed bun, his throat got choked up and he burst into tears, finally bursting into tears.
"Alas", the village chief had no choice but to hold his hand and lead him to the house next door, where Xiao Lin Heqing's parents were kept.
The moment he saw the corpse, Lin Heqing's tears couldn't stop flowing. Lin Heqing knelt down next to his mother's body and kept crying, completely unaffected by Lin Heqing.
Lin Heqing seemed to be watching this scene from the air, but he couldn't control his body. It should be Xiao Lin Heqing who was back.
Lin Heqing watched his body follow the adults, and he would do whatever the adults told him to do.
It took the whole morning for the villagers to bury Xiao Lin Heqing's father and mother together.
Lin Heqing became more and more silent as he watched in the air, and became sad. He had just come to this world and became an orphan again.
Back home, Xiao Lin Heqing was lying on the bed, looking at the roof with his eyes open. Lin Heqing didn't know if he could see him, so he just said to Xiao Lin Heqing, "Don't be sad, everything will be fine."
After he said this, Xiao Lin Heqing spoke, "Brother, I'm leaving, I'm leaving with my parents." After saying this, he closed his eyes.
Lin Heqing felt that he had entered Xiao Lin Heqing's body again, and felt that Xiao Lin Heqing would not come back again.
He should have been reincarnated with his parents, so that's fine, as a family together.
"I will live a good life here," Lin Heqing vowed secretly.
The child's body was exhausted after a whole morning's exertion, and Lin Heqing lay on the bed and fell into a deep sleep.
"Aqing, get up and have dinner." It was Grandma Zhang. Grandma Zhang's thatched house was not far from Lin Heqing's house. Lin Heqing could walk there in five minutes, but for an old man with bad legs and feet, this journey might take twenty minutes.
Grandma Zhang also had a tragic fate. When Lin Heqing was playing in the grain drying field, he heard Zhang Tieniu's mother Zhang Wang in the village chatting with her daughter-in-law.
Grandma Zhang was originally the daughter of Zhang Zhuzhu, the head of Zhangjia Village. When she was young, she had a quarrel with her family for some unknown reason. She moved to the end of the village in anger and never saw them together in public places again.
Lin Heqing's parents settled at the very back because they relied on the mountain to cut firewood or collect herbs, so they decided to live at the very back.
"Hey, okay, grandma, you're here. Thank you for bringing me food." Lin Heqing opened the door. He invited grandma into the room and took the bowl she brought.
"Grandma, I'm embarrassed to ask you to bring me food every day. My mother has already taught me how to cook. I will try to cook on my own in the future. It's time for me to grow up."
"How about that? You are so small, can you get the stove?" Granny Zhang refused.
"Grandma, I have to learn to live by myself. How about I try first? If it doesn't work, I'll find you again."
Lin Heqing still plans to try life on his own first. After all, he is almost thirty years old at heart, and it is not good to always trouble the elderly.
Moreover, he still has secrets in his body and is not suitable to live with others.
After sending grandma away, it was actually only four o'clock in the afternoon. The village usually had two meals a day, but when the farming was busy, it was only possible to have three meals a day.
Just now, Lin Heqing woke up before his grandma arrived. He tried the "Lingqing Realm" space he got and found that he could enter it physically and soul together.
In fact, this is not called soul. According to the name of the immortal world, this is actually called consciousness or consciousness.Some people say it is called spiritual consciousness.
